page.title: Investments
page.description: Brokerage accounts synced automatically from your provider.

empty.title: No investment accounts yet
empty.description: Connect a Freedom24 account to start tracking its balance, holdings and trades automatically.

summary.mixedCurrencies: Accounts are held in different currencies, so there's no combined total. Each card below shows its own.

deleteDialog.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: This removes the account and its synced positions, snapshots and transactions from the app. Nothing changes on Freedom24 itself.

toasts.deleteFailed: Could not disconnect the account. Try again.

connect.title: Connect an investment account
connect.description: Enter the API keys generated on your broker's site — the app uses them only to read your balance, holdings and trade history.
connect.keysHint: Generate a key pair at freedom24.com/tradernet-api/auth-api. Keys are stored encrypted and can't be viewed again after saving.

toasts.connectFailed: Could not connect — check your keys and try again.

detail.syncCooldown: Just synced — you can sync again in a minute.
detail.gainLossLegend: Bars share one scale across holdings
detail.noHistory: No history yet — check back after the next sync.

news.title: Market news
news.description: Headlines from your selected market-data provider, filtered by holding or search term.
news.emptyDescription: Try a different term, or clear the filters to see the whole feed.
news.failedDescription: The provider didn't answer. Try again shortly.
news.needsAccount: Connect an investment account first — news comes from your broker's feed.
news.storyFailed: Couldn't load this story. Try again shortly.
news.noBody: This story has no article text. Open the original to read it.

search.title: Ticker search
search.description: Look up any instrument via your selected market-data provider, with its latest quote.
search.placeholder: Search by symbol, company name or ISIN…
search.idleDescription: Type at least two characters — try a ticker like AAPL, or a company name.
search.emptyDescription: Nothing found for "{{query}}". Try a shorter term or a different spelling.
search.failedDescription: The provider didn't answer. Try again shortly.
search.needsAccount: Connect an investment account first — search runs against your broker's instrument list.

providers.label: Data source
providers.comingSoonDescription: This data source isn't wired up yet. Stick with Yahoo Finance for now.

research.title: Company research
research.description: Look up any listed company or fund on Yahoo Finance — profile, quote and key stats.
research.placeholder: Enter a ticker, e.g. AAPL or MSFT…
research.idleDescription: Enter a ticker symbol to see its profile, valuation and business summary.
research.failedDescription: No Yahoo Finance data for "{{symbol}}". Check the ticker and try again.

edit.title: Edit investment account
edit.description: Name, icon and description are yours to edit. Balance, positions and transactions are always set by the {{provider}} sync.

toasts.updateFailed: Could not update the account. Try again.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate API keys
rotateDialog.description: Replace the stored public/private key pair for this account. The next sync runs immediately to confirm the new keys work.

toasts.rotateFailed: Could not update the keys — check them and try again.
